title: Prep Cues + Evidence Bank — Manager Conversation
content:
Purpose: quick, scannable bank of cues and concrete evidence I can drop into a manager conversation or 1:1 agenda. Not polished — scratchpad for phrasing, numbers, and open questions.

Top-line goal for conversation
- Primary: align on impact signal and next career step (leveling/promo readiness).
- Secondary: get explicit runway and concrete development experiments (owners + deadlines).

Quick script options (pick one)
- Data-first: "This quarter I shipped X which increased adoption by Y% (see metric). I want to learn how to scale this work and take on program-level ownership. Can we map the concrete gaps and a 3-6mo plan?"
- Problem-first: "We have a recurring issue with cross-team onboarding for new SDEs affecting time-to-value. I led a small pilot that reduced ramp by 18%. I want to own a broader onboarding playbook — need your help clearing bandwidth and sponsorship."

Anchor stories (STAR style, super short)
1) Ownership: "Launched onboarding playbook pilot"
   - Situation: new hires taking 10+ weeks to hit first milestone.
   - Task: create streamlined onboarding + role checklist with infra team.
   - Action: ran 3-week pilot, created templates, held 2 workshops, automated checklist reminders.
   - Result: ramp time median reduced from 10 -> 8 weeks (18% improvement). Adopted by 2 teams.
   - Evidence: onboarding-survey-Q2 (link), ramp-metrics-dashboard (JIRA-5392).

2) Cross-functional influence: "Negotiated hosting quota increase for Dedicated pilot"
   - Result: secured additional dedicated capacity for Beta customer, avoiding SLA violation. Pilot revenue at-risk avoided (~$45k).

3) Experiment that failed (useful): "Early caching change increased variance in latency"
   - Why include: shows measurement rigor, learned to add canary + latency alarms before rollout.

Concrete metrics to drop in
- Adoption: number of teams using playbook = 2 -> target 5 by EOY.
- Cost avoided / revenue impact: ~$45k (dedicated quota negotiation).
- Efficiency: ramp time median 10w -> 8w (18%).
- Latency variance post-change: p95 increased by 30ms in canary.

Asks (clear, single-line)
- Career: "Recommendation on next-level readiness and 3 concrete development goals for the next 6 months (mentorship, cross-team program to lead, measured outcomes)."
- Resourcing: "Sponsor to unblock 0.2 FTE from infra for onboarding automation for 3 months."
- Visibility: "Intro to Director of Platform to discuss scaling playbook across Dedicated and Private."

Development experiments I want to try (proposal)
- Co-lead a cross-team onboarding guild (run 6 sessions, capture playbook improvements).
- Shadow product ops planning once per sprint for two sprints to learn roadmap prioritization.
- Run a short series of 1:1s with two senior PMs to build stakeholder negotiation habits.

Calibration notes (what I need from manager)
- Explicit examples of the behaviors/outputs that map to next level at Redwood.
- A calibration signal (OKR or milestone) we can use to judge progress.
- Honest read on timeline: 6 months realistic? 12 months?

Risks / concerns to call out
- Bandwidth: current sprint load + hiring work may make it hard to own a program without dedicated backup.
- Perception: risk of being seen as "only onboarding" — need to frame as platform-level adoption work.

Follow-ups I will bring if manager asks for evidence
- Link to onboarding-survey-Q2 (qual feedback).
- Ramp-time table export (spreadsheet): per-cohort medians.
- Slack thread: onboarding-pilot-feedback (select quotes).

Open questions I want to ask during conversation
- From your perspective, which of these three stories best signals leadership scope? (onboarding playbook, quota negotiation, measurement rigor)
- What would make you comfortable writing a strong recommendation eventually?
- Are there internal stakeholders I should prioritize building relationships with (names)?

Notes-to-self / immediate TODOs before 1:1
- Export ramp-time chart and one slide summary (top-line + 1 graph).
- Pull 3 short quotes from onboarding survey (anonymize).
- Draft 2-3 measurable success criteria for the next 6 months.
- DM manager draft agenda and ask for 15 min prep feedback.

Unresolved / fringe ideas (brainstorm)
- Small sponsorship pilot: link one onboarding metric to onboarding-time-based bonus for mentors. Needs PM + finance review.
- Create a shallow "onboarding health" dashboard in Console: include median ramp, onboarding-completion %, first-week NPS. Could be a 1-sprint proto.

Quick copy for Slack (post-1:1 follow-up)
- "Thanks for carving time. Per our talk: I'll own the onboarding playbook rollout experiments and will share success criteria by EOD Friday. Appreciate your help with identifying sponsor and a 0.2 FTE unblock."

Version history / notes
- v0.1 2025-08-14: initial scratch.
- v0.7 2026-03-11: added calibration notes and metric exports list.

TODO (post-1:1)
- Add manager feedback to evidence bank.
- Turn top 3 success criteria into an OKR and add to product-ops board.

---
Meta: keep this doc short, copyable, and intentionally messy. Use it as a scratchpad before creating a cleaner manager-brief one-pager."
